meta.name: Bang Baang
meta.description: Raghu faces the biggest test of his life when he is a prime suspect in a high-profile murder case. Meera, his ex-girlfriend is closing onto him at the same time. Will the truth prevail or will the case get murkier?

videos.title: Welcome to Udaipur
videos.overview: Meera leaves her engagement celebrations due to a new case. Raghu receives a warning. Action, Mystery

videos.title: And They Meet Again
videos.overview: The police are hot on Raghu’s tracks. Meera investigates Princess Ramona’s murder and comes across a new lead. Ajay comes up as another suspect.

videos.title: The Rear Window Game
videos.overview: Meera arrives at Ajay’s house and finds Tanya, meanwhile, Monisha abducts Raghu. Tanya tells Raghu and Meera about Ajay’s routine.

videos.title: Fly Before You Die
videos.overview: Raghu hands over an envelope to Monisha. Meera traces Raghu to a market in Udaipur. Monisha kidnaps both Raghu and Meera. Later, Monisha is found dead.

videos.title: The Infamous Reunion Party
videos.overview: Raghu is interrogated in connection to Monisha’s murder. Raghu, Meera and Rohan arrive at the location where Princess Ramona’s reunion party took place.

videos.title: She Is Back!!!
videos.overview: Pari, Vikram’s daughter gets kidnapped. Shimona receives death threat by an unknown identity. Meera arrives in Mumbai to arrest Raghu.

videos.title: Mask Man Revealed
videos.overview: Raghu tries to deduce the events to find the identity of the masked man. Raghu visits Ritesh Mehra, while Meera visits Shimona.

videos.title: Whos Next
videos.overview: With Siddharth’s death, the case of Princess Ramona’s death is closed. But, Raghu proves that Ramona is alive.

videos.title: The Deadly Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: Meera seeks Rohan’s help to decode the encrypted laptop. Princess Ramona unfolds the events of the reunion party through a video message.

videos.title: Final Bang Bang
videos.overview: Raghu has locked Meera and Rohan in a basement. After finding out the complete truth Raghu and Meera are ready to punish the culprit behind it all.
